valid.code: switch (x) { case 1: return Handler.one(); case 2: return Handler.two(); default: return Handler.fallback(); }
valid.name: single-statement (return) case bodies - not flagged

valid.code: switch (x) { case 1: Handler.one(); break; case 2: Handler.two(); break; }
valid.name: single delegating call plus trailing break - not flagged

invalid.name: braced case body - flagged regardless of statement count (existing baseline: any explicit block wrapping a case body is disallowed, not just multi-statement ones)
braced multi-statement case body - flagged (existing baseline)
braceless multi-statement case body - flagged (bypass: switch-case bodies do not require braces, so consequent statements attach directly to SwitchCase with no BlockStatement node)
braceless multi-statement case body with no trailing terminator - flagged
